C-TABLE-PROFILE-SCHEMA.IntentSummary: Extract the independently maintained persisted table-layout schema decisions of Muya sanitizePersistedEntries (M-012) and renderer migrateTableEntry (M-061 store side) into one new pure owner src/muya/lib/tableResize/tableLayoutSchema.js, with both existing consumers delegating to it through thin, boundary-explicit adapters. All current observable results are preserved: renderer persistence keeps its explicit-Auto reset, rounding without a display floor and unit-sum ratio normalization; Muya direct keeps its 48 px clamp, copied (non-normalized) ratios, array-shaped raw acceptance and direct explicit-Auto record shape. Proof is direct shared-owner characterization, both consumer APIs, store round trips and the existing Chromium/webkit-tables browser scenarios; delivery runs on integ/techdebt through a fresh technical-debt lane with separate admission.
